panels.title: Diagnosis Matrix
panels.description: Surface-level funnel counts shown as one table. Expected is the planned jobs per selected surface; Submitted is the accepted create response count; Visible and Target state are work observed after that response. Campaign and cron runs now wait for terminal completion before cleanup.

panels.title: No Data Warning
panels.description: Warns when selected filters have no PerfPulse expected-job samples in the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Expected Jobs
panels.description: Planned work count across selected surfaces. Cron currently expects one job per surface; campaigns expect campaign.totalJobs per selected surface.

panels.title: Jobs Submitted
panels.description: Accepted create responses from the selected surface. This is a count; submission duration is measured separately as request start to create response.

panels.title: Jobs Visible
panels.description: Work observed through the selected surface after the accepted create response.

panels.title: Cleanup Failures
panels.description: Cleanup failures recorded by PerfPulse for selected filters.

panels.title: Run Outcome Trend
panels.description: Accepted and visible work by test and surface over time. Completion is part of the per-job lifecycle; Kueue admission remains a separate diagnostic signal.

panels.title: Target State Reached
panels.description: Target-state percentage by surface: visible work divided by expected jobs for the selected run. Completion latency and failures show whether visible work reached a terminal state.

panels.title: Target State Failures
panels.description: Visibility failure percentage by surface: visibility failures divided by expected jobs for the selected run.

panels.title: Submission Latency
panels.description: Create request duration by surface, measured from request start until the create response returns. This does not include later visibility, admission, or completion time.

panels.title: Visibility Latency
panels.description: Post-submit visibility latency by surface, measured from accepted create response until the Job, Kueue Workload, or Skaha session is visible. This excludes submission duration.

panels.title: Completion Latency When Observed
panels.description: Post-submit completion latency, measured from accepted create response until terminal completion. Campaign and cron runs now wait for completion before each lifecycle iteration finishes.

panels.title: Kueue Admission Latency
panels.description: Post-submit Kueue admission latency, measured from accepted create response until the Kueue Workload is admitted. This excludes submission duration.

panels.title: Cleanup
panels.description: Cleanup coverage and failure percentages by surface, divided by expected jobs. Cleanup failure is an event signal, so use the diagnosis table for exact counts.

panels.title: k6 Runtime
panels.description: k6 runtime load and execution health panels.

panels.title: Dropped Iterations
panels.description: Dropped k6 iterations by test and scenario.

panels.title: Iterations
panels.description: Completed k6 iterations by test and scenario.

panels.title: Virtual Users
panels.description: Active virtual users by test and scenario.

panels.title: Checks Pass Rate
panels.description: k6 check pass and failure ratios for selected filters.

panels.title: Data IO
panels.description: k6 network data sent and received rates from byte counter metrics.

panels.title: HTTP Analytics
panels.description: HTTP request rate, failure, and duration panels.

panels.title: HTTP Requests
panels.description: HTTP request rate by request name.

panels.title: HTTP Failure Rate
panels.description: HTTP failure rate by request name.

panels.title: HTTP Duration p95
panels.description: p95 HTTP request duration by request name.

panels.title: HTTP Duration Heatmap
panels.description: HTTP request duration distribution by bucket.

panels.title: Kueue Cluster State
panels.description: Best-effort cluster-wide Kueue queue and controller health panels.

panels.title: Kueue Workloads Admitted
panels.description: Admitted workload count by cluster queue.

panels.title: Kueue Workloads Pending
panels.description: Pending workload count by cluster queue and status.

panels.title: Kueue Controller Restarts
panels.description: Total Kueue controller container restarts over selected range.

panels.title: Kubernetes API State
panels.description: Kubernetes API request and workload pod state panels.

panels.title: API Server Request Rate
panels.description: API server request rate for job and workload operations.

panels.title: API Server p95 Latency
panels.description: p95 API server latency for job and workload operations.

panels.title: Workload Pods Running
panels.description: Running workload pods by selected namespace.

title: PerfPulse Overview
description: Operator overview for PerfPulse run health, workload progress, k6 runtime behavior, HTTP behavior, and cluster signals. Submission latency is create request duration; visibility, optional completion, and Kueue admission latency start after the accepted create response. Percent panels use expected jobs as the denominator.
